_doc: Verdict registry for MAP-12 (docs/mapping-rules.md): a Chat Completions
request body read INTO a canonical Request. Every key the wire can carry
has exactly one verdict here; tools/audit.py enforces the registry two
ways against the corpus (every top-level key, content-block type, tool
type and tool_choice form that appears in a chat-dialect case body or an
ingest-surface case body must have a verdict) and against the scraped
OpenAI reference (scrapes/openai/pages/chat--create.md: every documented
top-level body parameter must have a verdict). An implementation refuses
any key with no verdict; the registry is what makes 'no silent drop'
checkable rather than hoped.
Verdicts:
map        - reads into the named canonical field.
extensions - passes verbatim into config.extensions[key]; the builder
re-emits extensions verbatim, so the key round-trips. Only
generation knobs OpenAI documents and no canonical field
expresses; a chat server receives them unchanged.
refuse     - UnsupportedFeatureError naming the key; the reason says
what the canonical model cannot carry and where to put it.
call-mode  - read and dropped: says HOW the request is sent, not WHAT is
asked; a canonical Request has no stream flag. The one
bucket that drops, closed at two keys, stated in MAP-12.
default    - a value equal to the wire's default (response_format
{type: text}, function.strict false, logprobs false); reads
as absent because the wire bytes are the same either way.
'when' documents a preset condition the reference checks (the compat
policy is data; the spelling another server owns is refused, because it
would be sent and ignored). The code is the truth; this file is the
closed list the code must cover.

parallel_tool_calls.to: Config.tool_choice.parallel (a ToolChoice(mode=auto) is created when tool_choice is absent)

max_completion_tokens.note: both spellings are read on every preset; both present and unequal is malformed (ValueError)

stop.to: Config.stop (a bare string becomes a 1-tuple, INV-020)

logprobs.to: Config.logprobs (true -> 0, or top_logprobs when given); false is 'default' and reads as absent

top_logprobs.to: Config.logprobs = n; without logprobs: true it is malformed (ValueError)

response_format.to: Config.response_format (INV-050): json_object; json_schema {name, schema, strict}; {type: text} is 'default' and reads as absent; name 'response' is the builder's default label and reads as absent; description is refused (no slot)

user.note: one end-user identifier only: user, safety_identifier and user_id together is malformed (ValueError)

user_id.when: compat.user_field == 'user_id' (DeepSeek); refused elsewhere - not an OpenAI field

reasoning_effort.when: compat.thinking_format in (reasoning_effort, deepseek, kimi); refused where the server spells its dial otherwise or has none

thinking.to: Config.reasoning: {type: disabled} -> off; {type: enabled} needs reasoning_effort beside it (refused alone: lm15's dial is a level, MAP-7)

enable_thinking.to: Config.reasoning: false -> off; true is refused (no level on this wire)

chat_template_kwargs.to: Config.reasoning: {enable_thinking: false} -> off; true is refused (no level)

reasoning_format.to: Reasoning.summary = 'auto' when an effort is present (MAP-7 rule 7); alone it is the documented extensions door and lands in config.extensions verbatim; any value but 'parsed' is refused

prompt_cache_retention.to: Config.cache.retention = 'long' for '24h'; 'in_memory' is refused (no canonical value)

prompt_cache_options.to: Config.cache: {mode: explicit} with no breakpoint -> mode 'off' (MAP-6 rule 2); with a breakpoint -> the breakpoint decides prefix / prefix_until_index; mode 'implicit' and ttl are refused

seed.reason: sampling determinism knob; no canonical field; harmless verbatim

logit_bias.reason: per-token bias map; no canonical field

metadata.reason: free-form request tags for OpenAI's stored-response dashboard (INV-049 blesses openai.metadata on the Responses dialect for the same reason)

verbosity.reason: OpenAI-only output-length preference; no canonical field

moderation.reason: OpenAI-only moderation policy object; no canonical field

provider.reason: OpenRouter's routing preferences object (the preset's compat.routing writes the same key); no canonical field

n.reason: lm15 reads one choice per response; n > 1 would silently lose choices. Fan out in the caller

functions.reason: the deprecated function-calling shape; declare tools as {type: function, function: {...}}

function_call.reason: the deprecated function-calling shape; use tool_choice

audio.reason: audio OUTPUT parameters (voice, format) have no canonical slot on the chat surface

modalities.reason: output modality selection has no canonical slot on the chat surface

prediction.reason: predicted-output content has no canonical slot

web_search_options.reason: a server-executed search the chat dialect cannot map to parts (MAP-1); the Responses dialect carries web_search as a BuiltinTool

top_k.reason: not an OpenAI field and the wire has no slot (the builder raises on Config.top_k, port.md rule 4); litellm forwards it from Anthropic/Gemini-shaped callers - a server that takes it does so through extensions

stream.reason: stream=... is an argument of complete()/stream(), not a field of Request

stream_options.reason: stream-frame mechanics (include_usage, include_obfuscation); the adapter sets them from its own compat when it streams

system.to: first row: Request.system (a lone text block becomes the string form); a later row: a developer Message

developer.to: as system: the builder writes Request.system under compat.instruction_role, so the wire cannot tell a system prompt from a leading developer message (lossy class leading_developer_as_system)

assistant.to: an assistant Message; parts in the fixed order reasoning_content (thinking), content (text / refusal blocks), refusal, tool_calls; content null with nothing else is one empty TextPart (MAP-2 applied to history)

tool.to: consecutive tool rows form ONE tool Message (the builder writes one row per ToolResultPart); tool_call_id -> id; name -> ToolResultPart.name

function.reason: the deprecated function-calling shape; use a tool row with tool_call_id

*.name.reason: a per-message participant name has no canonical slot (a tool row's name is the result's function name and maps)

assistant.audio.reason: an assistant audio reference has no canonical part

assistant.reasoning_content.to: ThinkingPart (a typed wire field, MAP-7 rule 12); read on every preset

assistant.tool_calls.to: ToolCallPart(id, function.name, json.loads(function.arguments)); a non-JSON-object arguments string is malformed (ValueError); type custom is refused

assistant.annotations.to: CitationPart per url_citation entry (url, title, text = the content span start_index..end_index); an empty list is nothing. The key the OpenAI SDK's and litellm's ChatCompletionMessage objects carry when dumped back into history (added 2026-09-08 after the first real message object was refused on it)

assistant.provider_specific_fields.reason: litellm's object model, not the wire: null, {} or a dict whose every value is null/empty reads as absent; a non-empty one is refused (no canonical part)

assistant.thinking_blocks.reason: litellm's object model: [] reads as absent; non-empty refused

assistant.images.reason: litellm's object model: [] reads as absent; non-empty refused

*.null-valued keys.reason: a key whose value is null reads as absent everywhere (the SDK's model_dump() writes audio: null, function_call: null, refusal: null on every assistant message)

image_url.to: ImagePart: a data URI -> inline data with the URI's media type; any other URL -> url (media type guessed from the path, else the ImagePart default; the wire carries none). detail -> detail. Admitted in user and tool rows

input_audio.to: AudioPart(data, media_type audio/wav | audio/mpeg). Admitted in user rows. The chat builder cannot carry it back out on any current preset (MAP-10): the Request is faithful and the send raises loudly

file.to: DocumentPart(file_id) or DocumentPart(data, media type from the file_data data URI); filename is refused (no slot). Admitted in user rows

video_url.reason: not in the OpenAI reference; a vLLM / DashScope convention with no receipt that any preset's server receives it. A VideoPart mapping waits for that receipt (the chat builder raises on VideoPart today, MAP-10)

*.prompt_cache_breakpoint.to: CacheConfig: on the system row's text block -> prefix 'stable'; on the last text block of message N -> prefix_until_index N; anywhere else is malformed (the builder places it nowhere else)

function.to: FunctionTool(name, description, parameters); strict true is refused (no per-tool slot; compat.strict_tools is a preset policy), strict false is 'default'

custom.reason: custom (free-form) tools have no canonical form

browser_search.when: compat.builtin_tools == 'groq'; refused elsewhere (the base wire has no such tool type)

function.to: ToolChoice(mode=required, allowed=(function.name,)); INV-031 then requires the name among Request.tools

custom.reason: custom tools have no canonical form

lossy.thinking_as_text: compat.thinking_replay == 'as_text' folds a ThinkingPart into the assistant text (MAP-7 rule 8, decision G); the wire carries no thinking field, and lm15 never parses delimiters out of text (MAP-7 rule 12), so it reads back as a TextPart
lossy.tool_result_name_omitted: compat.tool_result_name == 'omit' drops ToolResultPart.name from the tool row; the wire has no other slot for it
lossy.leading_developer_as_system: the builder writes Request.system and a leading developer Message to the same instruction row; ingest reads that row as Request.system
